title: Claude's memory works everywhere, and you decide what's in it
summary: Anthropic launched a unified memory system across Claude chat and Cowork that synchronizes and shares memory between both interfaces. Users can view, edit, and control stored information organized by topic, with sensitive data excluded by default. A single correction now updates memory everywhere Claude operates, eliminating repeated explanations.

title: Bain & Company joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier partner
summary: Bain & Company partnered with Anthropic as a Global Premier Claude Partner to help enterprises transition from pilots to production. Bain deployed Claude across its 19,000 employees through chat, Cowork, Code, Excel integration, and Microsoft 365, achieving 7,000+ active users within weeks. The firm reports 30–50% productivity gains in legacy code modernization engagements.

title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude in Chrome browser extension is now generally available on all paid plans, enabling Claude to read, click, fill forms, and autonomously execute safe actions on websites and internal dashboards. Enhanced security includes improved prompt-injection training, content scanning, and action verification, with testing showing a 0-0.3% attack success rate.

title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
summary: Claude Cowork now includes a built-in browser (rolled out to Pro, Max, Team, and enterprise users across macOS, Windows, and Linux) that operates independently from the user's personal browser, eliminating the need for browser extensions for web-based agent tasks. The private browser never accesses the user's tabs, bookmarks, or passwords unless credentials are explicitly shared.

title: Claude for Teachers, now available for schools and districts
summary: Claude for Teachers expanded from individual educators to schools and districts with free enterprise-level access including centralized management, single sign-on, and role-based controls. Two new teaching skills for lesson preparation and math assessment are now available, with FERPA-aligned terms and data protection from model training, free through June 30, 2027.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp built self-improving agents using Claude's Skills API with a two-skill architecture where an outer 'improver' skill observes user feedback and proposes updates to an inner domain-knowledge skill. This enables agents to learn from accumulated feedback without manual prompt rewriting while maintaining human control via code-review workflows, addressing the problem of agents plateauing at ~80% accuracy.
